Name: Ferngill Fashion Festival
Author: skellady
Description:
[left]
[center][size=2][img]https://imgur.com/hqcAdak.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]

﻿[size=3]Emily wants to put on a fashion show, but she can't do it all. Follow her journey through four new events, help her pick a model, and gather materials for her clothes, and then see the finished result when the festival kicks off on Spring 19.  Hat Mouse will also lend a paw and sell his hats alongside Emily's clothes, and another new vendor will offer fashion-related furniture items for your home.

Made for the Stardew Valley Discord mod contest July 2023![/size]


[center][img]https://imgur.com/e7p4ave.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]CONFIG:[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Mod Jam Mode[/b]: when set to true, removes the conditions on events and special order, so the events can be viewed immediately and the festival will happen in Y1.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Mod Shops Post Festival[/b]: when set to true, removes additional stalls beyond the base three until the festival has been seen at least once. Several stalls are decorative-only, while others are dependent on having specific mods installed (see the Compatibility section for details).[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/2HnJ2S1.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[color=#e06666][b][size=4]EVENT CONDITIONS[/size][/b] [b][size=2](do not apply if Mod Jam Mode is enabled)[/size][size=3]:[/size][/b][/color]

[list]
[*][size=3]Event 1:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Has seen Leah's 2 heart event, enter the Saloon anytime.[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=3]Event 2:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Has seen the first event, have four hearts with Emily, enter Emily's house anytime.[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=3]Event 3:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Has seen the second event, enter the farm between 6AM and 12PM.[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=3]Event 4:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Has seen the third event, enter Cindersap Forest anytime.[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list]

[b][color=#e06666][size=4]COMPATIBILITY:[/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village:[/url]﻿ Adds two new model choices.  Some of the fashion-forward Ridgeside villagers will attend. Also adds a stall for Faye.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley:[/url]﻿ Compatible with DSV sprites and portraits and vanilla townspeople will wear special outfits at the festival. If Marigold is enabled, she will also attend.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist:[/url]﻿﻿ Adds a stall for Rose, Hat Mouse's sister, when installed. Rose will also have a stall selling vanilla and mod-added (particularly from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]﻿) baked goods![/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10627]Yri the Architect:[/url]﻿ Yri and Charles will attend and Yri will wear several outfits showcased by Emily. (Hidden currently, won't show up)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿: Many of the Sunberry villagers will attend and Ezra will have a stall at the festival.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean:[/url]﻿ Jorts and Jean will attend.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey[/url] - Lacey will replace Hat Mouse for the event and festival stall.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in The Valley:[/url]﻿ The ARV gang will attend. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5760]Lumisteria's Clothes:[/url]﻿ Adds a stall when you have it installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]﻿: Adds Moira's stall when Lumisteria's Clothes isn't installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11446]Paisley's Bridal Boutique:[/url]﻿ Adds a stall when you have it installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24796?]Wear the Rainbow[/url]﻿﻿: Enables buying its clothing at a stall when you have it installed.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
